evidence: At 14.4-16.0 s the gripper holds the kettle over the left burner area. By 17.6 s it has let go: the kettle stands upright on the left burner's grate and the arm moves away. The wrist camera shows the kettle sitting slightly toward the back of the left burner, overlapping the rear of the burner cap rather than centred on it, but clearly on the stove. At 19.2 s the arm moves toward the front of the cooktop and the wrist camera faces the control knobs; no burner shows a flame or glow, so the left burner is not on yet. The robot is making normal progress on stage 2. Small doubt: the kettle is off-centre on the burner.
